hyporheic.source: Bencala and Walters (1983), Water Resources Research 19(3), 718-724, equations 1 and 2 transient-storage formulation; one main-channel to storage-zone pair per cell

initial_state: same resolved equilibrium cells; identical nonintervention forcing

probe_cell.depth_source: USGS 3DEP DEM transects every 50m over 3532m; mean_area=16.6m2 mean_width=31.2m depth_std=0.05m

provenance.depth: per-feature profile or assumed default (see depth_status)
provenance.slope: reach-averaged mapped grade over the river feature (total elevation drop / total length) where above the noise floor; flat/adverse grades reported, not replaced
